abstract: Maintains thermal grid return hydraulics records and baseload heat delivery quotas
system_message:
You are District heating network engineer (DIST). As the District heating network engineer (DIST), you oversee thermal grid return hydraulics records and baseload heat delivery quotas across regional network expansion projects.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains thermal grid return hydraulics records and baseload heat delivery quotas（THERM）
information_points.content:
DIST-THERM-GOC：For the Fractured crystalline basement stimulation scheme, municipal grid return absorption ready is confirmed as true at the municipal central heat substation junction, and projected baseload direct heat output is 60 GWh over a standard meteorological year.
DIST-THERM-U3T：For the Multilateral horizontal collector scheme, municipal grid return absorption ready is false at the municipal central heat substation junction, while projected baseload direct heat output is 60 GWh over a standard meteorological year.
DIST-THERM-D5S：For the Deep carbonate aquifer doublet scheme, municipal grid return absorption ready is confirmed as true at the municipal central heat substation junction, and projected baseload direct heat output is 90 GWh over a standard meteorological year.

information_points.title: Network pumping telemetry（FLOW）
information_points.content:
DIST-FLOW-4MF：Operational telemetry logs for the Multilateral horizontal collector scheme register a distribution pumping head requirement of 70 m along the candidate district feed loop under design winter flow conditions.
DIST-FLOW-UGQ：Operational telemetry logs for the Deep carbonate aquifer doublet scheme indicate a distribution pumping head requirement of 85 m along the candidate district feed loop under design winter flow conditions.
DIST-FLOW-2NI：Operational telemetry logs for the Fractured crystalline basement stimulation scheme record a distribution pumping head requirement of 55 m along the candidate district feed loop under design winter flow conditions.
